qualification: Previously inspected development heart cases, including multiple crops from one collage. All original photo records are identical. Error deltas are comparable only with unchanged crops, target masks and observation coverage. Earlier records without observation coverage scored the complete square, including outside-photo padding. Derived-mask checks and sparse material samples do not certify original cutting paths or physical assembly. Search allowance is ten seconds; timings are not browser latency. Failure categories describe measured gates, not established root causes.

runState.scope: 31 complete original-photo cases; retain 15 incomplete and one obscured inventory rows. Fresh automatic crop and binary Mal mask, ten-second search allowance. Editable SVG replay follows; browser timing was measured separately.

ribbonFeatureAudit.qualification: All old feature pixels remain observed and white in the new classified mask; none is recovered by either exported weave. A new connection to the square border changes the source-feature admission. The improved derived-mask pass is not recovery of that old feature, and its physical paper/artwork identity remains unverified.

visualReview.scope: All 31 current source/crop, classified-mask and editable-weave rows visually inspected across four sheets; jigsaw compared with its previous native weave, and bird native/editable renders inspected individually.
findings: Jigsaw resembles the unchanged target substantially better, but small protrusions and distorted corners remain; the crop is not verified ground truth.
Crossed ribbons has a cleaner broad shape but still loses the old 72-pixel border component; changed classification now joins that component to the border.
Bird, crown, puppy and Viking remain visibly imperfect despite passing the quantitative checks. Bird neck and border gaps already appear in the native export, before editable conversion.
Dense and warped checkers retain wavy boundaries; several outlined motifs retain uneven joins. Bauble loses frame details before fitting and remains rejected.
Nested squares and Santa still have no supported automatic crop; outlined star still loses its near-border component.
visualReview.notClaimed: 27 checks passing does not mean 27 faithful original cutting templates or physical assembly validation.

comparisonLimits.jigsawAttribution: The successful current fit uses finer paper verification at resolution 700; the old report discards coarse-uncertain checkpoints. Many solver changes separate the runs, so the full improvement is not attributed to the latest deadline fix alone.
comparisonLimits.timeBudget: Ten-second search allowance, with detection, preparation, finalization and independent export checks recorded separately; not an end-to-end ten-second photo latency claim.
